resources.string: Sign in to your account to continue.
Your account is connected. You can close the app and resume your session when you return.
The email address or password is incorrect.
Verify your email before signing in.
Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
The service is currently unavailable. Please try again.
The Supabase connection has not been configured for this environment.
Enter your email address and password.
With an account you can contact professionals, book appointments and leave reviews.
Already have an account? Sign in
We will email you a link. Open it on this phone to choose a new password.
If %1$s was not registered yet, we have sent you a link to activate your account. Open it, then sign in with your password.
I have verified it: sign in
Email sent. It may take a few minutes; check your spam folder too.
If an account exists for that email, you will receive a link to choose a new password.
This link is invalid or has expired. If you opened it on another device, request a new one from this phone.
Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
That password cannot be used: use at least 8 characters and not your previous one.
Could not sign in with Google. Try again or sign in with your email.
No appointment requests in this conversation.
Pending: not confirmed and the time is not reserved.
Request sent. Waiting for the professional’s proposal.
New appointment request: review it and send a proposal.
Proposal received (version %1$d): waiting for your decision.
Proposal sent (version %1$d): waiting for the client.
You rejected the proposal. The professional can send another one.
The client rejected the proposal: you can send another version.
Only this professional will see it once you send the request. It never appears in searches or in the chat.
Could not get the location. Type the coordinates of the job location.
You don’t need to set a price: the professional will send you a proposal.
Visit fee if nothing is repaired: %1$s
Reject version %1$d? It stays in the history and the professional can send another one.
Check the details: fields are missing or the time is not valid.
You don’t have access to this appointment or your session has expired.
Not accepted: check that the time is in the future and the values are in range.
That location is outside this professional’s service area.
The appointment changed in the meantime. Check the current version before sending again.
This operation was already sent with other details. Check the history.
Not confirmed. Check your connection and retry: it won’t be duplicated.
JPEG or PNG, any size. The app sends a compressed copy of up to 1600 px and 2 MB; your original is not changed.
Only JPEG or PNG photos can be sent. The photo was not sent; choose another one.
The server rejected the photo because of its size. It was not sent; try another one.
Photo storage is full. The photo was not sent; try again later.
You are not allowed to send photos here or your session has expired. The photo was not sent.
This photo does not match an earlier send. It was not sent; choose it again.
The photo could not be confirmed. Retry: it will not be duplicated.
The photo could not be opened. Tap to retry.
Could not load the review. Check your connection.
Your profile has not been submitted for review yet.
Under review. It will not appear in the catalogue until administration approves it.
Your changes are under review. Meanwhile the approved version stays visible.
Approved and published in the catalogue.
Rejected. It does not appear in the catalogue.
Changes rejected. The previously approved version stays visible.
Proposed provisional price. It is optional: your free profile stays complete.
See benefits and try the simulation
“Featured” slots in searches within your areas
This is how a promoted slot is labelled
It could only appear in the municipalities you cover: %1$s.
No areas yet: a “Featured” slot only appears once your profile is approved, and only where it provides service.
It always carries the “Featured” label. It does not guarantee a fixed position or customers, and it does not change distance in nearby search.
The subscription does not buy verification or profile review.
Simulation: no card or bank details are requested, nothing is charged, renewed or invoiced.
The subscription could not be loaded. Check your connection.
You do not have permission or your session has expired. Nothing has changed.
The change could not be confirmed. The last confirmed state is still shown; try again.
The map is not configured in this version. Use the list: search and manual choice work the same.
This device cannot show Google Maps. Use the list: search and manual choice work the same.
The map is not loading. The list is still available.
Tap here to see the profile
%1$d of %2$d have no public business location: they only appear in the list.
No result has a public business location. See the list.
Choose the municipality where the job will be done and, if you see the map, tap the approximate point. No street or number needed.
Municipalities could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
No municipalities are available right now.
Tap the map to place the job point.
Without a map, distance is measured from a point inside the chosen municipality.
Open the point in Google Maps
No app can open Google Maps. Install Google Maps or a browser.
Choose the point on the map
The point does not replace the address: type the street and number.
You are accepting version %1$d, free of charge. The appointment will be confirmed and that time reserved in the professional\'s agenda.
This version has a cost. Confirming it with payment is not available yet: you can reject it or ask for another version in the chat.
Confirmed: %1$s, %2$d min. The time is reserved.
That time is no longer free in the professional\'s agenda. Nothing was confirmed; the request stays open for another time.
Weekly hours in mainland Spain time. Pending requests and proposals reserve nothing: only a confirmed appointment occupies the agenda.
Could not load the agenda. Check the connection.
You do not have permission or your session has expired. Nothing changed.
Check the data: each slot must end after it starts (HH:MM) and the duration must be between 15 and 1440 minutes.
That time overlaps a confirmed appointment or another block. It was not blocked.
This attempt was already recorded with different data. Check the blocks.
Could not confirm with the server. It is not shown as saved; try again.
Your profile could not be loaded. Check your connection.
With this same account you can keep hiring and also offer your services. First create the profile, then complete it and submit it for review.
Profile created. Complete it and submit it for review.
Correct what was pointed out and submit it again. Administration will decide on the new version.
The concejo list could not be loaded. You can remove areas but cannot add new ones right now.
If you work from home you do not have to publish your address: the concejos where you work are enough.
Complete the marked fields: name, trades, concejos, languages and a valid phone.
Once submitted, administration will review it before it appears in the catalogue.
Changes are reviewed before they are published. Meanwhile the approved version stays visible.
Submitted. It is pending review and is not shown as published until it is approved.
The server refused the data. Check the fields and submit again.
This submission was already recorded with other data. Submit again to create a new version.
Your session cannot change this profile. Sign in to your account again.
The server could not confirm it. It is not shown as submitted; try again.
Not published and not sent for review. Only you can see it.
Agenda and availability are changed from your account and need no review.
We use it to find professionals nearby and to suggest it when you request an appointment. You can change it later from your account.
Only you can see this address. It never appears on your profile or in searches.
No results. Try writing it differently or type it by hand.
Type the address and mark the point myself
Address autocomplete is not available. Type the address and mark the point on the map or use your location.
Could not get a precise location. Mark the point on the map or try again.
Tap the map where your home is.
The point is missing: choose a suggestion, use your location or mark it on the map.
Check the address: it cannot be empty and the point must be valid.
Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
You have not set your home address yet.
Outside Asturias: nearby search only works there.
You are about %1$s km from your home address. Do you want to change it or search from where you are?
We filled in your home address. Change it if the job is somewhere else.
